Hi Nina — Logan from SE here, thanks for confirming. Confirming a few operational details so we come prepared: 

Agenda (60 min core + 30 min breakout):
- 0–10m: Introductions & product overview (security + procurement attend)
- 10–40m: SE technical walkthrough — architecture, routing, caching, SLOs
- 40–60m: Live session — model routing and latency profiling on a sample prompt
- 60–90m (optional): Deep-dive with Lars on access/config and a short runbook walk-through

Pre-demo asks (we'll produce a 1-page data handling note):
- Confirm dataset choice (synthetic or obfuscated prod). If prod-like, we will provide a data handling statement and recommend obfuscation steps.
- Temporary network access: we typically request either (A) short-lived SSH tunnel to a lab instance or (B) allowlist of Redwood IPs for the demo window. Details in the attached runbook.
- SOC2 / subprocessors: we can share our SOC2 in progress summary and subprocessors list; if you need an off-the-record artifact we can arrange via secure link.

SE who will attend: Logan Wright (SE Lead) and Priyom Das (Systems Engineer).
Questions for procurement: can procurement confirm the PO/contract contact so we can follow procurement timeline post-demo?
